Practice

What is the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent?

A chatbot usually answers a request, but an AI agent can plan and use tools to work toward a goal.

What is one goal you would like an AI agent to help with?

Why is an AI agent more like a teammate than a normal tool?

It can connect several steps toward a goal, instead of only waiting for one direct instruction.

Would you prefer AI as a quiet tool or as an active teammate?

What does a lead agent do in an agent team?

It breaks the work into smaller jobs, gives tasks to subagents, and combines the results.

What task in your life could be divided between several helpers?

In the teacher example, what does the agent swarm create?

It creates a first version of research, vocabulary, questions, image ideas, and review notes.

If you were the teacher, what part would you check most carefully?

What changes in the 2035 work screen example?

The human spends less time on small steps and more time directing agents, checking quality, and deciding.

Would this kind of work screen make work better or more stressful?

What might students need to explain if they use AI agents?

They may need to explain which agent helped, which sources were used, what they rejected, and what they improved.

If an AI agent described your school, job, club, or project, what should it understand?

Why should agents not receive every permission at once?

Because powerful agents can cause real damage if they make mistakes or act in unexpected ways.

What action should always require human approval?

What are the three possible futures in this section?

The lesson describes a useful future, a noisy future, and an unfair future.

Which future worries you most, and what could reduce that risk?

Summary

AI agent swarms are not only a technology story.

They are a human story.

The main question is not whether machines can work faster.

They can.

The main question is whether humans can guide that speed wisely.

By 2035, many people may work with teams of digital helpers.

The best workers may be strong at giving goals, checking sources, judging quality, and taking responsibility.

The most important skill may be human judgment: knowing what should be done, what should not be done, and what must be checked before the world sees it.
